title: Ful Medames
description: Slow-cooked fava beans mashed with garlic, cumin, and lemon, drowned in olive oil and topped with tomato and parsley. Egypt's everyday breakfast.
notes: Two 400 g tins of ful, drained, skip the soak and most of the cooking — warm them through with a splash of water.

steps.text: Soak the dried fava beans overnight in plenty of cold water.
Drain, cover with fresh water, and simmer very gently until completely tender.
steps.tip: Ful is traditionally cooked overnight in a pot-bellied qidra. A lid and the lowest flame are the home version.

steps.text: Crush the garlic with the salt and cumin, then mash half the beans with it, the lemon juice, and some of the cooking water until creamy but still chunky.
Spoon into bowls, pour over plenty of olive oil, and top with the tomatoes, parsley, and chilli flakes. Serve with the pita breads and halved eggs.
